sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरत: प्रत्यनन्तरम् ।उवाच परमोदार: सूतं परमदुर्मना: ॥ २.१११.१२॥
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharata: pratyanantaram ।uvāca paramodāra: sūtaṁ paramadurmanā: ॥ 2.111.12॥

translations.english: Having been addressed by Rama in this way, Bharata of great generosity, in extreme distress, addressing the charioteer who was standing nearby said:
